item.title: Alpex Solar Pumps ₹10 Cr in Subsidiary, Expands Module Capacity to 2.4 GW
item.description: Greater Noida-based solar module maker Alpex Solar Ltd has invested up to ₹10 crore in its wholly owned subsidiary Alpex Green Energies Private Limited (AGEPL) to support business expansion, working capital needs and operational strengthening. Alpex Solar’s board said in a regulatory filing about approving the infusion of additional equity capital as part of its long-term strategic growth plans. item.title: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Posts 6% Rise In Quarterly Revenue; Exports Weigh
item.description: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Ltd reported a 6% year-on-year rise in quarterly revenue, helped by strong demand from automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), even as exports declined due to geopolitical tensions. The Hyderabad-based company posted standalone revenue from operations of 3,350.84 crore rupees for the quarter ended Dec. 31, 2025, compared with 3,164.02 crore rupees a year earlier. item.title: Plus Power Launches 175 MW Battery Project In Maine, Largest On ISO New England Grid
item.description: U.S. energy storage developer Plus Power said on Thursday it has begun operations at its Cross Town Energy Storage facility in Gorham, Maine, marking the largest battery project connected to the ISO New England grid. The 175 megawatt/350 megawatt-hour utility-scale battery system stores surplus electricity during periods of low demand and dispatches it during peak periods, helping balance intermittent renewable generation, improve grid reliability and reduce price spikes. item.description: Indian energy storage startup Electrent Energy plans to expand into hybrid solar inverters and electric two-wheeler batteries as demand for lithium-ion storage grows, its chief executive said. item.description: Advait Energy Transitions Ltd is accelerating its expansion into battery energy storage systems (BESS) and green hydrogen as part of a broader strategy to diversify beyond power transmission EPC projects and deepen its role in India’s energy transition. item.title: Advait, Equentia, Sundrops Win GUVNL’s 335 MW/670 MWh 2-Hour Cycle BESS Tender
item.description: Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam (GUVNL) has awarded its 335 MW/670 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) tender to three bidders, two months after issuing it. The 2-hour cycle BESS tender under the VGF scheme was awarded at tariffs ranging from Rs 2.10 lakh/MW/month to Rs 2.12 lakh/MW/month. The winning companies are Advait Energy Transitions Limited, Equentia Natural Resources Pte Ltd, and KPI subsidiary Sundrops Energia. item.title: Saatvik Green To Add 4GW Of New Module Line In April, Cell Production Likely By Oct
item.description: Indian solar module manufacturer Saatvik Green Energy plans to begin commercial production of solar modules from its new 4 GW plant from April this year. item.title: AP: NTPC REL Issues 215 MW Wind Project Tender for INGEL at Anantapur-II Substation
item.description: NTPC’s renewable energy arm, NTPC Renewable Energy Limited (NTPC REL), has recently issued a wind energy tender to develop a 215 MW wind energy project for IndianOil NTPC Green Energy Private Limited (INGEL). IndianOil NTPC Green Energy Private Limited (INGEL) is a 50:50 joint venture between Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) and NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL). item.title: SaurEnergy Explains: What are Battery Cycles Metric, Why it Matters?
item.description: Battery Cycles is a commonly used phrase in talks about battery energy storage systems (BESS).
